steps.run: metric add val_loss --minimize --unit nats

steps.run: experiment add e --id e1 --purpose x --baseline fp32 --candidate int8 --varies precision
out: Experiment e1: e · fp32 (baseline) vs int8 (candidate) · varies precision
purpose: x
Planned: nothing in the record tests it yet, and it shows as a planned direction until its first run or analysis.
Made 2 variants: fp32 (baseline), int8 (candidate); a setting of one is rb spec set e1 fp32.<setting> <value>.
e1 declares it varies precision, but no variant has a value for it yet; give each variant its own: rb spec set e1 <variant>.precision <value> --source <file#key>
Next: rb spec set e1 --from <config.yaml> --keys "<the keys that define it>"  ·  rb criterion add "<what it should show>" -e e1 -q <question> --metric <name> --at-most <x>

steps.run: spec set e1 fp32.precision fp32 --no-verify
out: e1/fp32.precision = fp32 · provisional

steps.run: spec set e1 int8.precision int8 --no-verify

steps.run: spec set e1 seed --per-run

steps.run: spec set e1 batch --per-run --design-factor
out: e1/batch · per-run: each run gives its own, with --set batch=<value> on rb run add
Fixed design factor: comparisons across its cells are descriptive, with no sampling interval across cells.
